## Design

### 2026-10-01 — I came into this project beliving that I would be absolutely find and that I could figure everything out as I go because like how hard can building hardware actualy be. It was only when I began design

**1.5h**

I came into this project beliving that I would be absolutely find and that I could figure everything out as I go because like how hard can building hardware actualy be. It was only when I began designing this that I realised how horribly wrong I was. So,the entire hour was spent with me familiarising myslef with online simulators and found a free and realtively easy one to use. Then I learnt how the wiring worked and what goes where and began designing online.

My only advantage was the fact that I can code which was less of an advantage than I thought it would be. The original designing part of my ten hours did not use code at all,meaning that my advantage was quite literally defenestrated.

So a million crash outs and occasional sugar driven dopamine highs later I have created the basic bones of my project and have connected the Raspberry Pi Pico 2W with and MAX30102 Heart Rate sensor with a TM1637 for the visuals.

The will come the pain of learning how to code in micropython instead of actual python, and how to deal with all of these extra components and the= many things I Wnt to add but just don't know how. BUT that's a problem for tomorrow, right now,I will be taking a huge nap.
